purpose: Add a deterministic sprite-map presentation with integer overlay gradients while preserving the inherited VM81 runtime as the only gameplay mutation authority.

authority.projection_rule: The sprite renderer receives const authoritative state, returns pixels and hashes, and must leave the complete release state byte-identical.
forbidden: media generated from a different playthrough than the captured sprite stream

framebuffer.arithmetic: integer interpolation and integer alpha blending only

classes: HUD life, checkpoint, and progress indicators
sprite_map.camera_projection: world pixels are translated only by the authoritative camera_x_px field
sprite_map.animation_projection: player sprite frame is selected only from authoritative animation_state and animation_frame

overlay_order.name: ATMOSPHERE_GRADIENT
overlay_order.description: vertical sky gradient plus deterministic cloud and star texture

overlay_order.name: PHASE_OVERLAY
overlay_order.description: diagonal gradient lanes derived from VM81 phase and Lo Shu state

overlay_order.name: SPRITE_MAP
overlay_order.description: terrain, hazards, checkpoints, goal, and player sprite projection

overlay_order.name: CHECKPOINT_GOAL_GLOWS
overlay_order.description: integer radial glow fields around checkpoint and goal coordinates

overlay_order.name: HUD
overlay_order.description: lives, checkpoint state, and goal progress

overlay_order.name: VIGNETTE
overlay_order.description: edge-distance darkening applied after the readable gameplay layers

required_invariants: same authoritative state plus same overlay flags yields byte-identical RGBA output
same RGBA output yields identical Hash72 and Hash216 frame identities
rendering preserves the complete HHSVM81GameRelease state byte-for-byte
invalid overlay flags fail without state mutation
insufficient output capacity fails without state mutation
an admitted VM81 gameplay transition changes the projected sprite frame
base, atmosphere, phase, glow, and full-composite layer hashes are distinct
the complete sprite frame sequence is ordered and chained by Hash72 and Hash216
sprite screenshots and MP4 are generated from that exact captured sequence
presentation evidence remains bound to victory, two checkpoints, 19/19 opcode coverage, replay MATCH, final Hash72, and final Hash216

presentation_evidence.video_scaling: 4x nearest-neighbor from the exact 160x144 sprite frames
required_checks: video codec, resolution, frame rate, frame count, duration, and nonempty size
